supersession_reason: V2 evidence ledger: every blob_sha256 is a 64-char SHA-256 of the cited file at the source baseline revision; every cited range includes its full atomic wording; EL-UI-001, EL-RESP-002, EL-RESP-003, EL-ROUTE-001 ranges were widened so all semantic anchors are reachable; EL-LOOP-001 wording no longer claims that elapsed timing changes a terminal-state return.

claims.claim_text: The Batch A discovery audit lists Enchanted Library as canonical identity vocabulary/enchanted-library and admits two page candidates.
claims.extracted_fact: The discovery artifact names the identity and the advantage-games and reading-advantage page candidates.
claims.interpretation: Denominator/source pointer binding only; no behavior conclusion.

claims.claim_text: The advantage-games catalog entry has id enchanted-library, title Enchanted Library, an enchanted-library href, and status playable.
claims.extracted_fact: The catalog literal contains the id, title, href, and status values.

claims.claim_text: The committed advantage-games vocabulary fixture contains eleven term/translation objects; each shown entry has term and translation fields.
claims.extracted_fact: The JSON array has eleven entries and each entry has term and translation fields.
claims.interpretation: Source-derived content boundary; no language or UX conclusion.

claims.claim_text: The state type includes playing, gameover, and victory statuses, player, spirits, books, targetWord, mana, vocabularyProgress, timing, difficulty, and maxSpirits fields.
claims.extracted_fact: The TypeScript state declaration enumerates these fields and status literals.

claims.claim_text: The difficulty type is easy, normal, hard, or extreme; the difficulty configuration assigns spirit counts, spirit speeds, and xpMultiplier for each value.
claims.extracted_fact: The source defines four difficulty literals and four configuration records.
claims.interpretation: Difficulty configuration is recorded; application of xpMultiplier is not inferred here.

claims.claim_text: The logic defines an 800 by 600 game area, player radius 20, spirit radius 15, book radius 25, initial mana 50, three shield charges, a 2-second shield duration, a 3-second spirit spawn rate, and a 180000 ms game duration.
claims.extracted_fact: The constants are explicitly declared with these values.

claims.claim_text: State creation rejects an empty vocabulary, initializes one zero progress entry per vocabulary term, and chooses the initial target by random index.
claims.extracted_fact: The function throws for length zero, fills a Map with zeroes, and computes targetIndex from rng().

claims.claim_text: Initial state places the player at the arena center, starts with no spirits, initial mana, inactive shield, zero game time, full remaining duration, and difficulty-derived spirit settings.
claims.extracted_fact: The returned object contains the listed initial values and derived fields.

claims.claim_text: Book spawning creates one correct book using the target term and translation, then filters out the target term and takes up to three decoys.
claims.extracted_fact: The function pushes one isCorrect book and maps the decoy slice into isCorrect false books.
claims.interpretation: Answer-choice construction; the source does not guarantee four books for vocabularies with fewer than four non-target entries.

claims.claim_text: Book placement samples positions inside 50-pixel edge padding, rejects positions within 150 pixels of the player or within three book radii of placed books, and uses a corner fallback after 20 attempts.
claims.extracted_fact: The placement loop contains the padding, distance checks, attempt limit, and fallback branches.

claims.claim_text: Spirit spawning returns the input state when the spawn timer is positive or the spirit count has reached maxSpirits, and otherwise predicts player position using supplied velocity and a 50-unit look-ahead.
claims.extracted_fact: The two guards and predicted coordinates are explicit.

claims.claim_text: A spirit chooses one of four walls, computes a normalized velocity toward the predicted point at the current spirit speed, sets the spawn timer to 3000 ms, and increases next spirit speed by 15 percent capped at 25.
claims.extracted_fact: The wall switch, normalized velocity, timer assignment, and capped speed calculation are present.

claims.claim_text: Collecting a correct book adds 10 mana subject to a zero floor, increments the target word's progress, restores one shield charge up to the player's maximum, and may select a next target when vocabulary is supplied.
claims.extracted_fact: The correct-book branch changes mana, shield charges, progress, and targetWord as shown.

claims.claim_text: Collecting an incorrect book subtracts five mana subject to a zero floor and leaves the target word unchanged in the shown branch.
claims.extracted_fact: The false branch subtracts MANA_LOSS_INCORRECT and contains the target-preservation comment.

claims.claim_text: Next-target selection filters vocabulary to words with progress below two and chooses randomly from that set; when none remain it chooses randomly from the full vocabulary.
claims.extracted_fact: The function has an incompleteWords filter and separate empty-set and non-empty random branches.

claims.claim_text: The victory predicate returns false if any vocabulary progress count is below two and true after all entries meet or exceed two.
claims.extracted_fact: The loop checks count < 2 and returns true after iteration completes.

claims.claim_text: Shield activation is a no-op when already active or when charges are zero; otherwise it sets a 2000 ms timer, marks active, and consumes one charge.
claims.extracted_fact: The guards and returned active/timer/charge values are explicit.

claims.claim_text: A spirit collision while the shield is active reflects the spirit velocity and marks the spirit bounced; without the shield, the first hit by a spirit reduces mana by ten and marks that spirit as having hit the player.
claims.extracted_fact: The active branch computes reflection and bounced; the inactive branch checks hasHitPlayer, subtracts mana, and sets the flag.

claims.claim_text: The main step returns terminal states unchanged, advances gameTime by dt, decreases timeRemaining by dt with a zero floor, and enters gameover when mana or time reaches zero.
claims.extracted_fact: The status guard returns state for non-playing statuses; timing updates and two gameover branches are explicit.

claims.claim_text: The main step consumes cast input for shield activation, derives four directional velocity components, normalizes diagonal movement, multiplies by player speed, clamps player coordinates to arena bounds, and decreases the spawn timer by dt.
claims.extracted_fact: The input, velocity, normalization, multiplication, clamp, and timer statements are in the step function.

claims.claim_text: Each playing step checks book collisions, updates spirits, checks spirit collisions, spawns a spirit when its timer is zero and below max, and sets victory when the victory predicate is true.
claims.extracted_fact: The pipeline calls the collision/update functions, applies the spawn guard, and sets status victory.

claims.claim_text: XP calculation returns zero for zero attempts, uses correctAnswers divided by totalAttempts for accuracy, adds bonuses for perfect accuracy, mana ratio at least one-half, and gameTime below 60000 ms, and caps the result at ten.
claims.extracted_fact: The function implements the stated zero case, accuracy, bonus branches, and Math.min cap.
claims.interpretation: Scoring formula; difficulty multiplier is not applied in this function.

claims.claim_text: The component loads player_3x3_pose_sheet.png, spirit_3x3_pose_sheet.png, book_3x1_sheet.png, and library_background.png from the enchanted-library vocabulary asset directory.
claims.extracted_fact: The Promise.all list contains four exact asset paths and load success sets the assets state.

claims.claim_text: The component resets state when vocabulary is non-empty and sets the phase to start in the reset effect; the start screen supplies four instruction entries, two control entries, a start callback, and difficulty selection.
claims.extracted_fact: Reset and phase effects are explicit; start-screen instructions and controls arrays are cited in the same component render.

claims.claim_text: On victory or gameover, the component computes accuracy and XP, stores results, invokes onComplete at most once through hasReportedRef, and changes the phase to ended.
claims.extracted_fact: Both terminal branches calculate results, guard callback invocation, and set ended.

claims.claim_text: The loading container uses h-[50vh], sm:h-[60vh], md:aspect-video and the game container uses h-[80vh], sm:h-[70vh], minHeight 320px, and md:aspect-video classes.
claims.extracted_fact: The two container className values and minHeight style are present.
claims.interpretation: Declared layout values only; no measured responsive conclusion.

claims.claim_text: The playing UI declares HUD overlays for mana, time, and shields, a target-word display, a grimoire button, off-screen indicators, a shield button, a VirtualDPad, and a Konva Stage sized from measured dimensions.
claims.extracted_fact: The cited HUD, target, grimoire, indicator, shield, VirtualDPad, and Stage elements are rendered in the playing branch.
claims.interpretation: UI inventory only; no input acceptance or visual-fit claim.

claims.claim_text: The playing branch renders an off-screen book indicator with clamped coordinates and rotation, a grimoire button with 44-pixel minimum dimensions, a shield button, and a VirtualDPad callback.
claims.extracted_fact: The indicator, grimoire button with 44-pixel minimums, shield button, and VirtualDPad JSX are present in the cited range.
claims.interpretation: Declared control/UI structure only; browser interaction remains out of scope for this collector.

claims.claim_text: The input adapter maps negative and positive dx/dy values to left/right/up/down booleans and maps cast truthiness to cast.
claims.extracted_fact: The returned DirectionalInput maps dx, dy, and cast as shown.
claims.interpretation: Input mapping only; no accepted-input/browser conclusion.

claims.claim_text: The advantage-games page dynamically imports EnchantedLibraryGame with SSR disabled and requests vocabulary from the enchanted-library API using a locale query parameter.
claims.extracted_fact: The page uses dynamic import with ssr false and fetches vocabulary with a locale query parameter.

claims.claim_text: The page fetches vocabulary at /api/v1/games/enchanted-library/vocabulary with locale, fetches rankings at /api/v1/games/enchanted-library/ranking, and posts completion data to /api/v1/games/enchanted-library/complete.
claims.extracted_fact: The three fetch URL strings and POST method are present.
claims.interpretation: Client API boundary inventory; no endpoint behavior is inferred.

claims.claim_text: The baseline unit test asserts that a four-item sample vocabulary creates four books, with one correct book and three decoys.
claims.extracted_fact: The test makes the three assertions against SAMPLE_VOCABULARY.
claims.interpretation: Test expectation only; not proof of implementation for other vocabulary sizes.
